origin.conversion: Cases are expressed as a base fixture plus a small patch list, or as a named builder that both the Python and the TypeScript suite implement identically. Placeholder numbers use {"$number": "NaN"|"Infinity"|"-Infinity"} because JSON cannot carry them literally.

builders.brief-too-many-relationships: brief B with 65 unique mustShareWall pairs
builders.brief-relationship-self-edge: a relationship whose two endpoints are the same room
builders.brief-relationship-unknown-endpoint: a relationship that names a room id not in rooms
builders.brief-duplicate-relationship-pair: two relationships over the same unordered pair
builders.brief-no-living-or-dining: every room retyped to bedroom or bathroom
builders.brief-min-site-axis-ok: site axes at the 3000 mm minimum (accept)
builders.brief-three-decimals-ok: room areas at three decimal places (accept)
builders.editor-document-over-64k: an editor document whose serialized size exceeds 64 KiB
builders.layout-below-authored-axis-minimum: one room rect consistent in area but under the authored axis minimum
builders.layout-omitted-room-also-present: a room id appears in both rooms and omittedRoomIds
builders.layout-zero-width-wall: an internal wall with zero width
